Pfizer's net margin in fiscal Q3 2025 was about 21.3%. This uses figures I recalled from its Q3 2025 report, not looked up, so they are approximate: revenue of about $16.65 billion and net income attributable to Pfizer of about $3.54 billion. Net margin is net income divided by revenue, so $3.54B ÷ $16.65B ≈ 21.3%.
